results.question: How many certified H-1B cases with a Business Analyst job title have a recorded worksite in Texas?
results.interpretation: Counts source rows (not distinct case numbers) where CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' exactly (Certified - Withdrawn excluded), VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly (H-1B1 and E-3 excluded), and title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'business analyst') = 1. That is a whole-phrase title match: 'Senior Business Analyst' and 'Business-Analyst' match; 'Business Analysts', 'Business Systems Analyst' and other unnamed classes do not. Worksite means the row's single recorded WORKSITE_STATE, normalized with UPPER(TRIM(...)) and matched to 'TX' (or the spelled-out 'TEXAS' if present). Additional worksites are not in this table.
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'business analyst') = 1 AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('TX', 'TEXAS')
results.rows_sql: SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'business analyst') = 1 AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('TX', 'TEXAS') ORDER BY sheet_row

results.question: Which employers filed the most certified H-1B cases, for any job title, with a recorded worksite in Boston, MA? Return the top ten.
results.interpretation: Ranks employers by count of source rows where CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' exactly, VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly, with no job-title filter, and the row's single recorded worksite is Boston, MA (UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)) = 'BOSTON' and UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('MA', 'MASSACHUSETTS')). Employers are grouped and labelled by TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) without merging different spellings; a NULL or empty name is labelled '[blank]'. Ordered by cases descending, then employer name ascending, top 10 as requested.
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EMPLOYER_NAME IS NULL OR TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) = '' THEN '[blank]' ELSE TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) END AS employer_name, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)) = 'BOSTON' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('MA', 'MASSACHUSETTS') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 ASC LIMIT 10
results.rows_sql: SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)) = 'BOSTON' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('MA', 'MASSACHUSETTS') AND (CASE WHEN EMPLOYER_NAME IS NULL OR TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) = '' THEN '[blank]' ELSE TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) END) IN (SELECT CASE WHEN EMPLOYER_NAME IS NULL OR TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) = '' THEN '[blank]' ELSE TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) END FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)) = 'BOSTON' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('MA', 'MASSACHUSETTS') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, 1 ASC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME), sheet_row

results.question: What is the median offered annual base wage for certified H-1B Data Scientist cases with a recorded worksite in California?
results.interpretation: Median of the offered annual base wage, CAST(WAGE_RATE_OF_PAY_FROM AS REAL), the lower bound of the filed wage range and not total compensation. Uses only rows where WAGE_UNIT_OF_PAY = 'Year'; other units are excluded, not converted. Filters are CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' exactly, VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly, title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data scientist') = 1 (whole-phrase match; 'Senior Data Scientist' matches, 'Data Scientists' and unnamed classes do not), and the row's single recorded WORKSITE_STATE is California (UPPER(TRIM(...)) IN ('CA', 'CALIFORNIA')). Uses the provided median() aggregate.
results.sql: SELECT median(CAST(WAGE_RATE_OF_PAY_FROM AS REAL)) AS median_annual_wage_usd FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data scientist') = 1 AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('CA', 'CALIFORNIA') AND WAGE_UNIT_OF_PAY = 'Year'
results.rows_sql: SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data scientist') = 1 AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) IN ('CA', 'CALIFORNIA') AND WAGE_UNIT_OF_PAY = 'Year' ORDER BY sheet_row

results.question: For certified H-1B cases coded as Data Scientists (SOC 15-2051), how many cases are at each prevailing-wage level, including blank?
results.interpretation: Counts source rows by prevailing-wage level where CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' exactly, VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly, and SOC code 15-2051 (Data Scientists). The SOC match is SUBSTR(TRIM(SOC_CODE), 1, 7) = '15-2051', so any O*NET suffix such as '.00' is included; no job-title filter is applied. Levels are grouped by TRIM(PW_WAGE_LEVEL); NULL or empty values are labelled '[blank]' and kept as their own row.
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN PW_WAGE_LEVEL IS NULL OR TRIM(PW_WAGE_LEVEL) = '' THEN '[blank]' ELSE TRIM(PW_WAGE_LEVEL) END AS wage_level, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND SUBSTR(TRIM(SOC_CODE), 1, 7) = '15-2051' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC
results.rows_sql: SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND SUBSTR(TRIM(SOC_CODE), 1, 7) = '15-2051' ORDER BY sheet_row
